tei:div.tei:p: 315) chos nyid mkha' 'gro'i thugs tig las: dgongs 'dus gnad byang bsdus pa gsal ba'i sgo byed gser gyi lde mig gsang ba'i rgya can bzhugs so: 316)thun skabs zhig la mkha' 'gro grub pa'i rgyal mo sha za kha che yin zer ba zhig gis skus gar bsgyur te 'di skad gsungs: he heḥ nga ye shes dbyings kyi mkha' 'gro ma: grub pa'i rgyal mo dbang mo che: nga 'khor 'das gnyis kyi spyi gzhi mo: 'jig rten 'das kyang 'khor ba'i tshul: pad+ma thod phreng bka' dam bzhin: gsang sngags bka' yi gnyer 'dzin cing: gsang 'dzin mchog la dngos grub ster: dam nyams rnams kyi srog tu babs: legs nyes stangs 'dzin ma mo rje: mkhyen gnyis ldan pa'i me long yod: mgon pad 'byung sprul pa bsam mi khyab: rang skal 317)chos gter sna tshogs 'byed: don gnyis mdzad pa mtha' ru phyin: yang gter sprul pa dpag tu med: khyod ni mtsho rgyal shel dkar mtsho'i: gsung thugs sprul pa mchog tu bsngags: rang skal brda don go bar gyis: zhes zer nas kun dga' dbang mo'i chos skor ma rgyud gsang ba snying po'i shog dril lnga pa'i nang tshan pad+ma mkha' 'gro'i gdams skor red: khyod la bdag gis gtad pa yin zer nas rin po che g.yu sgrom chung ngu gcig gi nang na mthing shog sngon po'i ngos la rgyu ma nges pa zhig gis bris pa'i brda 'di snang: (Dakini secret letter here) na mo dz+nyā na ḍā ki ye: 318) sku gsum mkha' 'gro'i tshogs la gus pas 'dud: zab lam mkha' 'gro'i thugs tig gnad byang 'di: pad+ma bdag gis mtsho rgyal khyod la gdams: ma 'ongs las can don du gter du sbos: de spyod skal ldan kun dga' tshul rdor 'byung: brda byang ji bzhin ma nor nyams len mdzod: gter gnas gnas chen gsum dang gnas phran lnga: grogs lnga chos bdag mchog dang yan lag tshul: las 'phro'i dbang gis dus dang dus su 'phrad: thugs tig zab pa'i chos 'byung zab mo ni:

rig 'dzin dgongs pa'i byin thob dgongs gter dang: mkha' 'gros rgyas gdab dbang thob thugs kyi gter: yang gter brda sprad gsang ba snyan brgyud dang: bka' babs dag snang rig gter dbang gter sogs: gter rigs m-i 'dra gsang gter du ma dbang: mkha' 'gro'i thugs tig zab mo'i chos sde ni: phrin las zab pa tshangs pa'i sgra dbyangs dang: nang sgrub rin chen snying po pad+ma'i rgya: gsang sgrub 'od gsal sgron me thig le'i rgya: phyag rgya bsdus pa 'khor 'das zil gnon dang: rgyun khyer spros med yang gsang snying po sogs: las mtha' man ngag las sbyor lag len dang: phyi sgrub dbang chus 319)skal ldan rjes 'dzin dang: gsang dbang spros med ral gri 'bar ba'i rgya: spro bskyed gter 'byung lo rgyus pad+ma'i phreng: thun mong thun min dbang chu yongs rdzogs dang: lag len gsal sgron them med rdo rje'i rgya: sku rgyud shel gyi ri bo bum pa'i rgya: gsung rgyud rlung ngag rang grol pad+ma'i rgya: thugs rgyud rdo rje'i rgya dang nor bu'i rgya: kun 'dus rin chen snying po gsang ba'i rgyud: bskyed rim rgyas pa nyi zla kha sbyor dang: 'bring bsdus yang gsang zung 'jug nyi ma'i snying: rdzogs rim 'od gsal kun bzang 'ja' thig dang: don khrid man ngag gsang bcud snying po'i skor: klong chen bum pa'i rgya dang gnad gsum don: gsang khrid ya bzhi 'chi srid gdams skor dang: rlung khrid man ngag skor dang de'i rgyab chos: 'ja' lus mngon byed 'od gsal thig le'i khrid: theg dgu'i gnad bsdus 'od gsal don khrid sogs: them med shog dril lnga pa'i gnad du chings: dngos grub 'byung gnas bdud rtsi'i sgrub pa dang: tshe g.yang nor sgrub rin chen za ma tog: sgos sgrub sgos dbang las chen las phran dang: dregs pa'i chos skor spu gri'i rgyud la sogs: gab byang dkar chag 320)chen mo ji bzhin gsal: de dag dus dbang bdud kyis ma bsgyur na:

dmag 'khrugs bskal ngan lnga bcu'i bar du bzlog: zab gter sgo 'byed gsang grogs lde mig ni: nga sprul nga dang gnyis med pad+ma'i rigs: spro thung rig pa hur zhing chos nyid mthong: nam snying bi ma zung sprul rasmi'i ming: gsang sbug sme ba lha yi spyan 'dra yod: 'brog mi'i sprul pa brtul zhugs ma nges spyod: las rigs shas+t+ra'i ming can nyams rtogs ldan: snyan g.yas sme ba nor bu'i dbyibs can mdzes: a tsar sa le'i sprul pa rin chen rigs: bi ma'i byin thob tiṣ+ṭha badz+ra rtsal: brla g.yon rdo rje'i mdud rgya'i ri mo yod: g.yu sgra'i sprul pa rtogs pa phul du phyin: rdo rje'i rigs can mkha' 'gro'i gsang mdzod dbang: 'gro 'dul ming can lus thung dpral sme mdzes: sangs rgyas ye shes sprul pa shes bya mkhas: mtsho rgyal byin thob pra wa ma ti rtsal: gnas gsum sme ba pad+ma'i dbyibs 'dra yod: de dag res 'ga' mi ring nye ba'i gnas: sngags rigs rtsing spyod tshul bzung rig pa 'dzin: res 'ga' gnas skyes smon lam dbang gis 'phrad: dus dbang le lo'i rkyen dbang ma gtong bar: pha yis 321) gdams pa tshul bzhin gces spras mdzod: yal bar ma dor snying gi dkyil du zungs: bdag gi rdo rje'i tshig la bslu med kyang: smon log sdig can bdud kyi cho 'phrul gyis: nga yi bstan pa res dar res mi dar: gter spyod bu yi thabs mkhas thugs rje yis: las ldan bu la rang skal pha phogs gtod: chos brgyad blos thongs dben rir btsan sa zungs: brag phug gnas bcas slong mo'i kha zas mchog: gshin po'i ro dom ma khur dman sa zungs: thugs bskyed smon lam 'gro ba'i don la brtson: bka' babs las can mchog gi bu chen ni: gu h+ya'i ming dang badz+ra shas+t+ra'i ming: ma ti'i ming dang sid+dhi bho dhi'i ming: mchog gi bu lnga smon lam dbang gis 'dzoms: gtso bo bu chen chos bdag nyer lnga ni: rma thog sprul pa shar gyi phyogs nas 'byung:

stag lo 'gro 'dul ming can sme zhal mdzes: rong chen g.yas nas nam snying sprul pa ni: dngos grub ming can brla g.yon sha mtshan yod: ka nam phyogs su khye'u chung sprul pa ni: rdo rje'i ming can rna g.yas phag dbus mtshan: gser smad phyogs su g.yu sgra'i sprul 322)pa ni: kun bzang ming can lte gsang thig le mdzes: shar gyi rong chen gnyis kyi sa mtshams na: bi ma'i thugs sprul nam mkha'i ming can ni: sha khra stag gi ri mo lte 'og 'khyil: shar smad sbas rdzong phyogs nas rdo rje'i ming: lus thung brla ngos dpal be'i ri mo yod: gnas 'di nas mi ring nye ba'i sar: dpal ye shes sprul pa rang grol ming: mgul 'khor lo'i ris mdzes nyams rtogs ldan: khams chab mdor bdud 'joms sprul pa ni: gter spyod mkhan yon tan rig 'dzin grags: mchan g.yon du ral gri'i ri mo yod: stod mnga' ris rdo rje'i sbas rdzong na: mgon pad 'byung thugs sprul 'od zer ming: snying thad na sme ba sum 'dzoms yod: spo rong du bai ro'i sprul pa ni: khong sbas pa'i rnal 'byor rin chen ming: mchan sme ba lha yi spyan 'dra yod: lha 'jam dpal sprul pa rig 'dzin dang: dpal khro lod sprul pa rigs las 'byung: dus ngan pa'i rkyen du ma shor na: gter gsum gyi 'gro don mtha' nas rgyas: 'gro yongs la bde skyid nyi ma shar: las can gyi chos bdag de dag ni: dus dus su smon lam dbang gis 'phrad: rang skal gyi gdams 323)pa la spyod nas: don gnyis kyi mdzad pa mthar phyin nges: gos dkar lcang lo'i sde tshan bcu dang ni: sum cu rtsa lnga yan lag tshul du 'byung: bya rgyal brag ri 'dzin pa'i rnal 'byor bdun: stag mo ri sul 'grim pa bco lnga 'byung: sa chen dang po thob pa nyer lnga tsam: khyung chen rtsal rdzogs lnga lnga rim gyis 'byung: sgyu lus zag zad zag med 'od skur grol: 'ja' lus chen po'i sku brnyes lnga 'byung ngo:

dge sbyong btsun ma'i sde tshan ma nges so: de ltar chos bdag skyes bu de dag ni: chos nyid don mthong 'phags nor mchog tu brten: dma' ba'i sa 'dzin 'gro don kho nar brtson: cha lugs mi dang mi bstun brtul zhugs spyod: bstan la dad cing gdams pa nyams len gzab: rdo rje'i tshig la the tshom yid gnyis med: gdams pa tshul bzhin nyams len skal ldan rnams: chos bdag skyes bu'i mtshan nyid shes par gyis: de dag smon lam dbang gis 'phrad nas kyang: rang skal chos kyi rten 'brel sgo 'phar 'byed: gter rigs mi 'dra du ma khyod la dbang: thams cad rten 'brel kho nar rag las pas: thabs grogs 324)chos bdag rnams kyis gzab gal che: de ltar rim bzhin gnad dang ldan gyur na: bdun bcur dpal ri pad+ma 'od du yibs: 'gro don sprul pa lnga tsam slar yang 'byung: thugs kyi sprul pa 'dod chu'i nye cha ru: sbas tshul rnal 'byor pad+ma bde chen rtsal: 'ja' lus dbang phyug bstan 'gro'i don du smin: bdud sprul smon log klu gong sprul pa ni: shrī'i ming can mi ring nye ba'i sar: ya ga sgro skur mi 'dod sna 'dren byed: a wa glang mgo dge btsun gzugs su sprul: cha lugs ya ma zung gis 'gro blo bsgyur: tshe spong sprul pa mi mo'i cho 'phrul gyis: dus dang dus su bstan la gdug rtsub ston: smon log dam sri btsun gzugs sprel la 'phyo: thabs shes nyi zla'i dkyil 'khor smag la khrid: dmar po lha gsum phrin las gzer gdab na: de dag rnams ni rim bzhin spong bar nus: tshe dang sgrub pa dben rir btsan sa zungs: chos brgyad dug gis bdud rtsi rul yang srid: 'phags nor mchog brten zab chos rang nyams longs: zab pa'i gdams pa zog po'i nor ma brje: gces spras gyis la skal ldan res 'gar spel: skal 325)med rnams la rlung phyogs tsam ma sgrogs: dman pa'i sa zungs gdams pa tsit+tar sbos: dam chos ring bsrel yid bzhin nor las lhag:

'di phyi'i re skong mchog thun dngos grub rnyed: 'chi srid dang po ka dag rang dbang thob: lhun grub pad+ma 'od kyi zhing khams su: rigs bdag pad 'byung rje dang dbyer med grol: gser dang ra gan ma nor rig pas dpyod: snyigs dus 'gro rnams bdud kyi dbang gyur nas: grub brdzun gter min bdud sprul gtsug tu khur: chos min chos kyis 'gro ba'i blo sems bsgyur: nges don yang dag lam sgrub nyin skar tsam: dal 'byor stong zad chos spangs las 'ga' bsags: 'di phyi gnyis phung mi 'dod sna tshogs 'byung: duḥkha'i gnas su yun ring sdug bsngal myong: de dag las spyod rang la rag las pas: pad 'byung bdag la gsol ba rgyun du thob: nga yis sbas pa'i gter gyis ma skyob na: gang gis skyob par mi nus rdo rje tshig: pad+ma'i pho nya las can gter spyod rnams: smon log bdud dbang dus kyis ma bsgyur na: mi 'dod bzhin du bstan 'gro'i gsos su smin: nor bu 326)rin chen 'dam gyis gos mi srid: skyid sdug ci byung gang snang lam du khyer: nyin mtshan dus kun pad 'byung gsol ba thob: yar mar tshes bcu'i dus kyi tshogs ma bcag: chos skyong dregs pa brngan mchod phrin las brtson: rang blo gzhan du shor na bdud dbang 'gyur: snyigs dus pha bu yin yang blo phugs med: kha byang ji bzhin ma nor nyams su longs: dus babs chos bdag chos gter 'byed pa'i thabs: rang rang brda byang gsal ba rig pas dpyod: bdud kyi bar chad bzang po'i lam nas bslu: brtul zhugs spyod pas rang blo thad kar chod: gdul bya snyan grags dmar po lha yis 'gugs: gter gsum 'gro don shar lho nub nas 'byung: nges med gnas su sgrub pa pha mthar skyol: lus dman dbang gis chos brgyad mdun ma bsu: thabs kyi dpa' bo snying 'dzin lcags kyus 'gugs: yid gnyis ma byed pad+ma'i bka' bzhin sgrubs: rdo rje'i tshig la bslu ba nam yang med:

gter ston e yong gter spyod rang la rag: nga yi bka' bzhin bsgrub na bslu ba med: dus dbang bdud kyis glo bur bar chad kyis: 327)rten 'brel gnad la gzab gal shin tu che: de dag dus babs brda byang rim bzhin gsal: rig pas dpyod la rang gter gces spras mdzod: tshul bzhin ldan na don gnyis mtha' ru phyin: mtha' dmag dus 'khrugs brgyad cu'i bar du bzlog: sa ma ya: chu la 'phyo ba'i rgya stag ngoms pa'i tshe: shar lho'i chu bya nag po nub tu bgrod: nub kyi rma bya'i rang mdangs 'gran zla bral: chu bya'i ngu 'bod sa gsum g.yo bar byed: sa the'i sprul pas dgon gsum bstan pa nyams: dmar po lha gsum bran du 'khol gyur na: shud bu'i sprul pas shar gyi bstan pa 'dzin: log spyod rang gi bya bas rkyen bskul nas: yul gzhi skyong ba'i srung ma yul gzhan bgrod: rkyen des mi 'dod sna tshogs rlung ltar 'tshubs: khyad par dmag 'khrugs nad yams mu ge dang: nye ba ru log nang 'khrugs dme sri dar: bsod nams longs spyod pre ta pu rir 'gran: chos bzhin spyod pa'i skyes bu nyin skar tsam: sgrub pa lhur len gang zag srid mtha' zhig: 'byung zhing mdo sngags dam chos gzugs brnyan 'dra: dus ngan de shar tshe na pad 'byung gi: 328)sprul pa'i skyes bu seng ge sgom chung na: sur+ya'i ming 'dzin zab mo gter la dbang: nag po bdud kyi 'bangs su ma gyur na: gang 'brel pad+ma 'od du 'dren par nges: lha ri g.yon du bdud 'dul sprul pa ni: badz+ra ming mthas gsang sngags srog shing 'dzin: pad+ma'i thang la sngar med bstan gzhi dar: yul phyogs de ru bde skyid nyi ma 'char: ka nam phyogs nas mi ring nye ba'i sar: tshe spong sprul pa badz+ra kīrti dang: bdud sprul bla gzugs mi dbang blo 'phrul gyis: stod kyi khu 'phang smad kyi phyogs su 'gyed: yul sde thams cad dmag jag las la brtson: mdo tshan gsum la khrag gi mtsho mo 'khyil:

phyogs min phyogs nas bai ro nam snying gi: sprul pa'i skyes bu tiṣ+ṭha badz+ra ming: tha mal tshul bzung zab mo'i don spyod pa: thabs mkhas thugs rje'i stobs kyis rtsal phyungs nas: bod khams re zhig bde ba'i go skabs shar: nyag la sngar med gser gyi me tog shar: dug sbrul sngon mo'i me lce phyogs su 'thor: nub kyi rgya stag kha ru tshud pa la: cang shes ngur mo'i gdong gi las brtson na: pha rol rgol ba ngan pa sel bar 329)nges: a tsar sprul pa yul de'i nye cha la: bstan pa'i bdag po dge btsun gzugs su ngoms: rang skal gdams pa'i snying po ma bsgrub na: chu gnyis 'dus sar khrag gi char pa 'bab: lha ldan phyogs su gos sngon 'tshub ma ldang: ra sa 'phrul gyi lha khang 'od dmar khyab: byang gi 'phar ba lce brgyad dbus su 'du: la lung thams cad ki co'i sgra yis gang: rten gsum gtso bo nyams pa'i grib kyis mnol: las su byas tshad 'di phyi gnyis 'phung byed: de dus lha sras sprul pa grol gyi ming: g.yu sgra nam snying bai ro lang gro yi: sprul pa dz+nyā na'i ming dang blo bzang ming: mkhas pa'i ming dang grags kyi ming 'dzin pas: lugs gnyis tshul gyis re zhig skyob par nges: brag dmar mda' ru sgyu ma'i ltad mo ngoms: ser po sogs kyi longs spyod sba la 'gran: g.yu yi ne tso'i yul gzhi 'khrugs pa'i dus: rta yi mgo la dug gi pad+mo bzhad: phyogs min phyogs nas smug po gdong la 'tshe: kya dang kla yis bstan pa'i kha dar dus: nyin re bzhin du mi rtag dus rnams 'gyur: lo 330)re bzhin du mi dang yo byad 'gyur: de dus pad+ma'i thugs rjes ma skyobs na: bod khams sus kyang skyob par lung ma bstan: nangs re dgong rer pad 'byung gsol ba thobs: dus rnams kun tu ma ṇi sid+dhi sgrongs: ri yi lto bar sa dpal 'dzoms pa la: sa bdag gter gyi bum pa bcud du sbos: lus ngag dge la bskul zhing chos la 'bungs:

mi dge sdig las phra mo tsam la 'dzem: bod khams mi bde sdug bsngal rin gyis nyo: hor sog mtha' mi 'bod pa rang gis byed: dus rnams mi 'gyur mi rnams 'gyur ba yin: de dus mi la bsod nams bde skyid med: pad+ma'i bka' lung bzhin du ma bsgrubs na: bod khams bde skyid chu yi ri mo 'dra: yul gru gcig min kun gyis 'di bzhin mdzod: 'jigs byed nag po bde mchog mgon po dkar: gshin rje 'char ka'i gtor bzlog gnad gal che: rta mgrin nag po tshe bdag gshin dmar gyi: sgrub mchod chag med brtson na bde bar gnas: mi g.yo gshin rje thugs chen srog gi rten: seng ha yab yum khro lod rta mgrin nag: gshin sngon gu ru drag po srog gi rten: 331)rta mgrin yang gsang thugs kyi sgrub pa dang: bde gshegs 'dus pa dang ni seng ha dmar: lha chen dmar nag badz+ra kī la ya'i: sgrub dang dkyil 'khor zhal phyes las rdzogs par: kun gyis rem na bde ba'i skabs mchi nges: xxsgang du wa yis seng skad 'don: zhwa dmar bstan pa gser gyi kha dog bsgyur: shar gyi rta bdun dam grib g.ya' yis bsgrib: srog gi rten phur dbang gzhu dbyings su yal: snga 'gyur bstan pa'i nyi zhal nub la nye: rnal 'byor chas rnams khyim pa'i gnas su mthong: 'dul bar rloms shing chos min sna tshogs dar: btsun pa'i chas zhugs tshong dang so nam byed: dug lngar longs spyod dkon cog rgyab tu bor: shi 'dren gson skyabs nag phyogs gdon la bca': pha ma dang ni drin can slob dpon la: bzang lan ngan gyis gso zhing rgyun du sdang: log 'tsho'i zas dang phung byed chung ma ni: gces pa'i srog dang bsdo zhing snying du bcang: dus ngan tha ma 'di ltar shar ba'i dus: pad 'byung mtsho rgyal 'jigs sgrol lha mo dang: rigs gsum mgon po 332)dang ni mchog gsum la: gsol 'debs skyabs 'gro nyin mtshan dus rgyun du: chag med brtson zhing lus ngag chos bzhin spyod:

de yis mi mthun nyes tshogs ngang gis zhi: mthun rkyen tshe bsod longs spyod 'phel bar nges: sa ma ya: (Dakini secret letter here) byang phyogs phag nag 'khun pas: lho yi rma bya'i mdangs bsus: brag gi spre'u'i blo sems: ngam nag sabhas bsgrib ste: mi 'dod ha la'i ku muta: gzhan min rang la 'gyed tshe: tshul khrims lha yi me tog: mi mngon dbyings su yibs 'gro: gter gnyis bstan pa'i ba dan: rlung lha'i dpe bzhin mi mngon: zung 'jug shes rab zab mo'i: mda' mo sgro ldan med tshe: bstan pa'i srog gi mar me: dri bzhon rkyen dang 'phrad la: ci cha cir 'gyur mi chod: mche ldan 'dzum mdangs ngoms tshe: tsan ldan dri bsung ngad pa: lho nas lho ru chas na: sngon 'byung smon lam mthu yis: rang skal grogs dang 'phrad nas: gter gnyis bstan 'gro'i gsos su: rim gyis gsal ba nges tshig: chos bdag pradz+nyā'i ming 'dzin: smon lam 333)mthu yis bskul nas: khyod dang 'phrad pas smin na: sngon gyi las 'phro sad tshe: gter gnyis bstan pa'i gsos su: rim gyis sman pa gsang tshig: bcu phrag lnga yi bar du: mu to'i tshul gyi spyod pas: zab lam sgom sgrub gnad bskyal: mchod sbyin tshogs gtor ma bcad: dben rir sgrub tshugs bzung nas: chos brgyad ring du spangs na: don gnyis rim gyis 'byung nges: de ltar stabs ldan med tshe: tshe chos sab+tas rkyen bskul: 'phral 'phral bar chad nye bas: stabs ka gzab pa gtan tshig: khye'u chung sprul pa'i rigs ldan: ngur mo'i lo khur dpa' bo: smon lam dbang gis 'phrad nges: de dang rten 'brel 'dzoms na: tshe chos gdul bya rgyas nges: gcig grogs gcig gis mthun rkyen: ma dang mkha' 'gros byed la: ci 'gyur brda don gsal yong: byang gi ngam nag khrod du: skyes bu rig pa'i ral gri'i: rang skal nor bu 'od 'bar: mu to'i gnas su lhung bas: dri bral shel dkar bum pa: nye min ring nas lon tshe:

snang srid gsal ba'i 334)me long: mthon mthing rtse ru bcings na: tshe mjug rang nor dang 'phrad: don gnyis mthar phyin 'byung srid: rang gnas mkha' 'gro'i 'du rar: ma he nyal 'dra'i ri yi: lto bar mkha' 'gro'i gsang gter: dgongs 'dus chos bcud zab mo: g.yu sgrom sna lnga'i rgya yod: dpa' bo grogs dang 'phrad nas: rang nor len pa tha tshig: thabs shes yun ring 'grogs pa'i: rten 'brel gzhan dbang med tshe: gter gnyis bstan pa'i ba dan: phyogs rnams kun tu dar nges: grogs dang chos 'dzin skyes bu: dus dang dus su 'dzoms tshe: rten 'brel sab+ta'i dbang du: ma gtong rig pas dpyod dgos: mkha' 'gro'i bka' bzhin khyod kyis: las dang bya bar brtson na: rang gzhan don gnyis nor bu: tshe 'dir mi 'gyangs lon nges: sngon smon 'brel ba'i skyes bu: rol pa'i rdo rje'i sprul pa: sgra brgya'i lo 'dzin shes ldan: gnas min gnas nas 'phrad yong: mkha' 'gro'i thugs bcud skor gnyis: yongs rdzogs gdams pa der gtod: chu 'dzin nag po'i rkyen gyis: gsal ba'i 'od sgrib med na: rim gyis bstan 'gror sman nges: chos 'dzin skyes bu 335)rigs can: don dang rig gi ming can: badz+ra dz+nyā na dharma: lo ka ak+ṣa bha dra: ga ga sa man dha ra: kīrti pradz+nyā rasmi: bsod nams ming can grogs bcas: glang nas cang shes bar la: rim gyis smon lam 'dzoms nges: de dang de sogs 'byung 'gyur: 'phral 'phral brda tshig gsal yong: chos brgyad dug 'dam khrod du: seng dkar g.yu ral ma ngoms: ḍā ki'i brda yis bskul tshe: lha ldan phyogs su dus yin: mi sems bdud kyis bsgyur nas: khyod kyang yul gzhan bgrod srid: sa ga zla ba'i 'bod pa: rang gi phyogs nas gsal 'ong: zab chos gsang ba skor bzhi'i: 'gro don dus la babs tshe: mthun rkyen lus med mkha' 'gros: dus su bsgrigs pa e nam: khwa ta rog po'i smon ngan: dus min dus su 'gyed tshe:

zla ba'i 'od dkar gzi mdangs: ngam gnag smag la gzab dgos: stod kyi brag gi spre'u'i: sgyu rtsal khyod la ngoms tshe: stabs gzab rten 'brel gal che: mi 'dod 'khrul pa'i brdzu bag: ngur mo'i gdong gis bsu bas: dmar po lha gnyis las la: bskul ba 336) gnad gal che nges: sa ma ra tha na ma: bha dra dha ri nir mi: mu tra thang kar i maṃ: bha gu la ste ku ra: ak+ṣa ma wa ri mi: sha za ḍā ki'i skad red: 'di don grol na rang skal: chos kyi brda byang gsang tshig: tsit+ta'i klong du sbas rgya: sa ma ya: brda thim: de dag mdor bsdus tsam zhig brjod pa yin: nga yi sprul pa nyi zer grangs dang mnyam: sems can ma zad 'gro don ga la rdzogs: mkha' 'gro'i sgrub skor gnad byang zab mo 'di: mtsho rgyal khyod kyis rin chen gter du sbos: ma 'ongs khyod sprul kun dga' la sogs dang: 'phrad nas 'gro don dpag med rim gyis 'byung: nga sprul nga dang gnyis med grogs dang 'phrad: chos bdag bi mo tsa dang las kyis 'brel: dmar po lha gsum bran khol mchod gsol 'bungs: phan bde'i 'od brgyas sa gsum khyab par nges: las can bu dang 'phrad pa'i smon lam bcas: drag mo mthu mo che la gnyer du gtod: phyi srung gnod sbyin gza' dang ma mos srungs: snying mig srog las phangs par gyur na yang: phyi rabs las can don du bdag gis gtad: skal ldan chos brgyud 'dzin pas 'di spyod 337)shog: skal med 'gro la rlung phyogs tsam ma 'phrad: thub par srungs shig gsang ba'i bka' srung rnams: dam nyams kha gsag can gyi dbang po snubs: dam ldan skyes bu'i phrin las ma lus sgrubs: gtad do srungs shig badz+ra sa ma ya: sku gsung thugs kyi rgya yod do: zab rgya: gsang rgya: gtad rgya: sbas rgya: gter rgya: gu h+ya: brda thim: :
